latest.headline: scagliox01 Claims Victory in Estonian Thriller
latest.paragraph: scagliox01 secured his third win of the season in Estonia, finishing with a total time of 36 minutes 35.84 seconds. While SubaruNyx demonstrated remarkable pace by clinching four stage wins, a series of penalties dropped him to third place. Flinnowaty maintained his consistent form to secure second, finishing 18.35 seconds behind the leader. Despite recording a DNF, Cefa217 showcased his speed by winning the Power Stage. The field faced a challenging event with four drivers failing to finish, as the championship battle continues to intensify following this high-scoring weekend for scagliox01.
